captions.detailed: A double-barrel floor pump featuring a wide rectangular black base and twin parallel light-grey cylinders. A single black T-handle assembly bridges the tops of both sliding metallic rods, which emerge from the cylinders. The entire T-handle and dual-rod assembly is designed to slide up and down, translating prismatically along the parallel vertical axes of the twin cylinders.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a double-barrel floor pump with a wide rectangular black base, twin parallel grey cylinders, and a single black T-handle bridging two silver sliding rods. Ensure the handle and rod assembly can translate prismatically along the vertical axis of the cylinders.
captions.factory: Create a base part using a chamfered box, and attach two parallel vertical cylinders representing the pump barrels. Model the piston rods as thinner cylinders, and construct the T-handle from a horizontal rectangular bridge connecting the rods, a vertical central neck, and a cylindrical cross-grip with end caps. Define a prismatic joint between the base assembly and the handle-rod assembly to allow vertical translation.
